questions.question: Which of the following Hindustani vocalists from Allahabad, along with her famed contemporary Gauhar Jaan, had the privilege of performing for Emperor George V at the Delhi Darbar in 1911?
questions.solution:
• Delhi Darbar 1911: Janki Bai
  • Fact: Known as 'Chhappan Chhuri', Janki Bai of Allahabad was a legendary Hindustani vocalist who performed for King George V alongside Gauhar Jaan.

questions.question: The nineteenth century saw the golden age of Kathak under the patronage of Wajid Ali Shah, the last Nawab of __________.
questions.solution:
• Kathak Patronage: Oudh
  • Context: Wajid Ali Shah, the last Nawab of Awadh (Oudh), was a great patron of the arts and is credited with the revival and 'Golden Age' of the Lucknow Gharana of Kathak.

questions.question: Who among the following Khayal singers of 19th century was given the title of ‘Tanras” by Bahadur Shah Jaffar, the last Mughal Emperor of India?
questions.solution:
• Khayal Legend: Meer Qutub Baksh
  • Title: Known popularly as Tanras Khan, he was a court musician for Bahadur Shah Zafar and founded the Qawal Bachon Ka Gharana of Delhi.

questions.question: Who among the following is credited with building Delhi’s Lāl Quilā (Red Fort)?
questions.solution:
• Lal Qila Builder: Shah Jahan
  • Architecture: Constructed in the mid-17th century, the Red Fort served as the main residence of the Mughal Emperors for nearly 200 years.

questions.question: Tansen, one of the well-known musicians of medieval India, was in the court of which of the following Mughal emperors?
questions.solution:
• Mughal Musician: Akbar
  • Fact: Tansen was one of the 'Navratnas' (Nine Jewels) in Akbar's court and is considered the father of Hindustani classical music.

questions.question: Malka Jaan of Agra Gharana was the court musician at the durbar of which of the following Nawabs of Calcutta?
questions.solution:
• Agra Gharana: Wajid Ali Shah
  • History: After being exiled to Metiabruz (Calcutta), Wajid Ali Shah maintained a musical court where Malka Jaan was a prominent singer.

questions.question: The first train inaugurated in 1853 was between which two stations?
questions.solution:
• First Railway: Mumbai and Thane
  • 1853: The first passenger train in India ran for 34 kilometers between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on 16th April 1853.

questions.question: Who among the following was the creator of the raag Darbari Kanada and a court poet of Akbar’s court during the Mughal period in India?
questions.solution:
• Raag Darbari: Mian Tansen
  • Detail: Tansen is credited with creating several iconic ragas, including Darbari Kanada (composed for the Emperor's court), Mian Ki Malhar, and Mian Ki Todi.
